items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of preliminary influent coarse and fine screening, vortex grit removal, biological treatment using anoxic basins and aeration basins including nitrification and denitrification, a membrane bioreactor system, and ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection.
